title: 21 December 1964: Rehearsal: Another Beatles Christmas Show
content:
Rehearsals began on this day for Another Beatles Christmas Show, The Beatles’ 1964 festive variety performance, at London’s Hammersmith Odeon. The show opened on 24 December 1964.

Page last updated: 24 April 2010

Also on this day...

  • 2020: Peter Jackson releases ‘sneak peek’ at documentary The Beatles: Get Back
  • 2009: Casting announced for Backbeat stage show
  • 2009: Paul McCartney hints at London concert residency
  • 1969: Mixing, editing: Get Back album
  • 1967: The Beatles’ Magical Mystery Tour launch party
  • 1966: Recording, mixing: When I’m Sixty-Four, Strawberry Fields Forever
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Gaumont Cinema, Bradford
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Star-Club, Hamburg
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
